FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game turns finding shapes in objects into a small story with a clear goal. Your child chooses a piece, predicts where it belongs, and sees the scene answer them at once — the exact noticing-and-trying loop that early maths is built on. The board forgives every miss with a hint, so trying again feels like part of the game rather than a mistake.

Keep the words flowing while they play: name the shapes out loud, wonder together — “where does the triangle go?” — and celebrate the finish with the same applause you would give a tower of blocks. Short and happy beats long and serious, every time.
